title: Four Health Measures Tell Different National Stories
hook: Some health risks fell worldwide while one country led a different ranking.
closing: Health progress depends on the measure; one headline can hide four very different realities.
question: Which health measure surprised you?

segments.say: Tuberculosis incidence fell to 131 per hundred-thousand people. One health burden eased across the world.
Infant mortality fell to 27.7 per thousand births. Health gains continued from infection into early survival.
Belarus leads at one in 96,213 for lifetime maternal death risk. National health rankings can reverse the global pattern.
Tobacco use fell to 20.3 percent of adults. Another health risk moved downward, but these gains are not interchangeable.
